_about: Starter quick phrases, copied word for word from the interview transcripts (pattani_dataset/pairs.jsonl, commit f81c7c0). Pattani Malay is written in Thai script. Review with a Pattani speaker before clinical use; replace with the main-PC phrase bank when available. Set "confirm": true on any phrase with a number, dose or frequency.
